name: project-garden-bridge
description: Local-only Project Garden progress with automatic anonymous Codex-project-to-plant binding, offline delivery, and decoration-insight updates.

interface.shortDescription: Let Codex projects grow one local plant across all their tasks.
interface.longDescription: A local Codex bridge that imports local Codex projects as Project Garden plants and routes progress from all tasks in the same project back to that plant through a one-way workspace hash. When the desktop app is closed, anonymous events wait in a local queue for its next launch. Project names, paths, files, code, token counts, and conversation content stay on this computer.
defaultPrompt: 完成这项工作后，如且唯如产生了具体可验证的进展，请用 Project Garden 本地工具记录匿名等级；同一 Codex 项目内的所有 task 都会回到同一株本地植物。若只产生真正的新方向或解决了实际分歧，可匿名记录为装饰灵感；不要发送项目内容、token 数或对话。
